decisions.reason: As an award-winning flagship product that is very close to the firm's established confectionery knowledge, it fits the firm's absorptive capacity especially well and shows strong market validation.
This bread builds directly on the firm's core baking capabilities and has stayed on the website across two years, so management is likely to keep and refine it rather than withdraw it.
The marzipan Christmas stollen is closely related to the firm's traditional seasonal assortment, making it easy to understand, produce, and improve within the firm's existing knowledge base.
